title: DILG chief: PNP ‘always expects the worst’ on VP impeachment verdict

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla said the Philippine National Police (PNP) “always expects the worst,” and “always prepares” for possible scenarios surrounding the verdict in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. “Wala naman expect na best dito sa PNP eh. we always anticipate, we always prepare,” said Remulla in an ambush interview on Monday in Camp Bagong Diwa, Taguig. (No one here in the PNP expects the best-case scenario; we always anticipate, we always prepare.) Remulla stressed that their role is to serve and protect the public, particularly when political decisions could […]...
